_about: Settings of the project IDE server. Paths are relative to the top of the repository, except repo, which is relative to this folder. The page is served from apps/project-IDE/current-ui/, the page store is kept in apps/project-IDE/data/page-store/, each request is logged in agents/system/logs/subagents/project-ide-agent/, and Claude Code starts in agents/system/, so the system's CLAUDE.md, agents and skills load as its own. No secret values here: the keys are named, and their values stay in the keys file on this machine.

voice._about: Voice input for the request boxes (voice.py): Groq speech to text. Models are tried in order; one that hits a rate limit or fails is skipped for the next. The key's value stays in the keys file.

send_options._about: Defaults of the send options in the Notes and runs panel; the page can change them for each send. where: local (a worktree on this server) or cloud (later). merge: auto (merge into main when the run ends done) or ask. tests: related, all or none. bug_check and report: true or false.

worktrees._about: Each run from the page works on its own branch ide/<date>-<subject>, in a worktree in this folder at the top of the repository (git ignores it).

runs._about: Runs are read from Claude Code's transcripts in <claude_config_dir>/projects/ (null: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude). A run is live while its transcript changed in the last live_seconds. max_text: characters of a step's input or output sent with the run; the rest loads on demand. summary_model writes each run's ASD-STE100 summary and tags.
